mapper.select: select zanzhu_jilu_id as zanzhuJiluId, zanzhu_renming as zanzhuRenming, zanzhu_leixing as zanzhuLeixing, coalesce(nullif(touxiang_url, ''), '/uploads/zanzhu/donor-default.jpg') as touxiangUrl, zanzhu_biaoti as zanzhuBiaoti, zanzhu_fangshi as zanzhuFangshi, zanzhu_jine as zanzhuJine, zanzhu_riqi as zanzhuRiqi, zanzhu_yongtu as zanzhuYongtu, zanzhu_shuoming as zanzhuShuoming, shenhe_zhuangtai as shenheZhuangtai from v_zanzhu_gongkai order by zanzhu_riqi desc, zanzhu_jilu_id desc

select yongtu_id as yongtuId, zanzhu_biaoti as zanzhuBiaoti, zanzhu_renming as zanzhuRenming, yongtu_mingcheng as yongtuMingcheng, yongtu_leibie as yongtuLeibie, shiyong_jine as shiyongJine, shiyong_riqi as shiyongRiqi, shiyong_shuoming as shiyongShuoming from v_zanzhu_yongtu_gongkai order by shiyong_riqi desc, yongtu_id desc

select w.id as wuziId, zr.zanzhu_renming as zanzhuRenming, zj.zanzhu_biaoti as zanzhuBiaoti, w.wuzi_mingcheng as wuziMingcheng, w.wuzi_leibie as wuziLeibie, w.shuliang, w.danwei, w.guji_jiazhi as gujiJiazhi, w.baozhiqi, w.ruku_zhuangtai as rukuZhuangtai, w.beizhu from wuzi_juanzeng w join zanzhu_jilu zj on w.zanzhu_jilu_id = zj.id join zanzhu_ren zr on zj.zanzhu_ren_id = zr.id where w.shanchu_zhuangtai = 0 and zj.shanchu_zhuangtai = 0 and zr.shanchu_zhuangtai = 0 and zj.gongkai_zhuangtai = 1 and zr.gongkai_zhuangtai = 1 order by w.id desc
